items.title: Pediatric Carbon-Fiber Running Blade & Athletic Socket
items.content_html: Funding custom prosthetics socket fabrication and a dynamic carbon-fiber running blade for a youth amputee track athlete.

_polytab.summary: Funding custom prosthetics socket fabrication and a dynamic carbon-fiber running blade for a youth amputee track athlete.
_polytab.plainSummary:
Cause: Insurance classifies athletic running blades as 'not medically necessary'.
Resolution: Custom-mold an athletic socket and fit running blade.
Proof: Certified prosthetist delivery invoice and fitting sign-off.

items.title: Unified Youth Track Uniforms & Free Pediatric Eye Screenings
items.content_html: Outfitting a unified middle-school track team (athletes with and without IDD) and offering free prescription sports goggles.

_polytab.summary: Outfitting a unified middle-school track team (athletes with and without IDD) and offering free prescription sports goggles.
_polytab.plainSummary:
Cause: Athletes with disabilities often play with ill-fitting footwear and uncorrected eyesight.
Resolution: Supply running uniforms and custom prescription sports goggles.
Proof: Screening clinician report and athletic uniform roster.

items.title: Brand-New Athletic Sneakers for Underserved Elementary Students
items.content_html: Measuring and delivering 50 pairs of high-durability, proper-fitting athletic sneakers to children in Title I schools so they can participate in gym.

_polytab.summary: Measuring and delivering 50 pairs of high-durability, proper-fitting athletic sneakers to children in Title I schools so they can participate in gym.
_polytab.plainSummary:
Cause: Kids wear worn-out, too-small shoes that cause blisters and prevent gym play.
Resolution: Measure each child and buy them brand-new running shoes.
Proof: School educator distribution log and shoe purchase invoice.
